task_description: Fix two user-reported visual problems in the MapTree Vue frontend: (1) apply visible CPF (000.000.000-00) and Brazilian phone ((00) 00000-0000) masks to the public self-registration screen RegisterComponent.vue while sending digits-only to the API; (2) replace the native prompt() used to capture a map marking note in PruningMap.vue with an accessible Vuetify modal, preserving all existing marker/icon/persistence logic.
